items.q: Can you take over an existing website?
items.a: Yes, after a review we take over hosting and support for most websites.

items.q: Will emails get lost when email moves?
items.a: No. We move the content and switch over in the right order so nothing is lost.

items.q: Will the site go down when the domain moves?
items.a: With the right planning there is no noticeable downtime.
